adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.formation_and_space: Dancers form a circle around four central singers

signature_moves.description: A masked dancer painted black performs a unique dance to represent the spirit god Koragajja.
signature_moves.name: Koragajja Dance

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Respect the sacred nature of the dance; outsiders should not impersonate Koragajja or disrupt rituals.

music_profile.musical_form: Songs include Karungilo and Aati Kalenje
music_profile.sound_description: Percussive drum beats with bell accompaniment underpin folk vocal songs sung in a call-and-response style, creating a rhythmic and spiritual atmosphere.
music_profile.vocal_style: Folk singing by four central singers wearing bells

basic_steps: Form a circle with 5 to 12 dancers
Wear costumes made from coconut and palm leaves
Dance to drum beats (Kaase or Dholu) and folk songs
One dancer wears a mask and black paint to represent Koragajja
Visit houses at night to collect offerings
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start by learning the circle formation and basic rhythmic steps; advanced dancers may perform the Koragajja impersonation.
